conditions.condition: Overpass mirrors return 429/504/502 clusters after 5 attempts per layer
conditions.action: stop acquisition, record attempted_unavailable in the source registry, continue with whatever was cached

conditions.condition: A distance band cannot be filled with 10 clean routes after the full candidate search
conditions.action: leave the shortfall as needs_review and report failed_quality_gate; do not pad with a false loop

conditions.condition: A route passes every numeric gate but is visually confusing (double loop, dumbbell, gourd, long stem, local retrace)
conditions.action: keep it needs_review; visual inspection overrides the metrics
fix the contract declaration, not the threshold

conditions.condition: Credits exhaustion, a real permission denial, or an unrecoverable environment fault
conditions.action: freeze the run, write the partial manifest, set status implementation_complete_unverified

run_level_rules: One Goal, one run ID, one independent build, one blind_checkpoint, one correction_batch.
blind_checkpoint is frozen once its manifest, hashes and check results are written.
The online reference product may be visited only after that freeze, and only once.
Process completion is never recorded as a quality pass.
